boundary: A tag says what Andrew's words talk about. It never says whether he liked it; his verdict is the quote itself.

decision.combine: mean of the forward-order and reverse-order Noul for the same tag

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` comment on how moving the player character feels: its handling, speed, control, momentum or traversal?

criteria.true: The verdict says something about how moving or traversing feels.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about how moving or traversing feels.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` comment on the shape or layout of the level: rooms, arenas, open space, or the size or structure of the play space?

criteria.true: The verdict describes or asks for a kind of level layout or play-space structure.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about level layout or play-space structure.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` express a view about exploring, roaming or discovering the game world?

criteria.true: The verdict mentions exploring, roaming or discovery, as praise or as a wish.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about exploring, roaming or discovery.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` ask for or comment on player abilities, augments, items, classes or mobility tools such as a grapple hook?

criteria.true: The verdict mentions abilities, augments, items, classes or mobility tools.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about abilities, augments, items, classes or mobility tools.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` comment on the physics simulation or movement model the build used, for example rigid-body versus kinematic physics, or its tuning?

criteria.true: The verdict names or compares a physics mode, movement model or its tuning.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about the physics mode, movement model or tuning.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` comment on pacing: how fast a run progresses, time pressure, the difficulty ramp, or how long things take?

criteria.true: The verdict says something about pacing, time pressure or the difficulty ramp.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about pacing, time pressure or the difficulty ramp.

tags.instructions: Does the playtest verdict in `verdict` comment on combat: fighting enemies, weapons, attacks or damage?

criteria.true: The verdict says something about fighting, enemies, weapons, attacks or damage.
criteria.false: The verdict says nothing about fighting, enemies, weapons, attacks or damage.

hand_labels.labelled_by: JL-20-A1 worker from the PLAYTEST-LOG Verdict bullets, before any Jev call

notes.1.movement_feel: "the implementation was off" is read as a judgement of the whole build, not of movement; the closest call in the set.
notes.2.exploration: "so fun to move and explore around" counts as exploring; the quote does not describe the level's layout, so level_shape stays false.
